name: Cultist: Blade of Yogg-Saron heals mark the healed Cultist with Void-Touched (#11428)
contract: Blade of Yogg-Saron 524887 and its rank 2 525078: damage dealt by Blade of the Empire 500720 heals the lowest
health ally with the direct heal 500748. With the Void-Touched passive 300286, that direct heal applies one
Void-Touched 301982 stack to the healed ally, as every direct heal from the Cultist does. A Cultist alone is his
own lowest health ally, so a rank 2 Blade of the Empire hit heals and marks him even at full health.

steps.label: CONTROL: the Void-Touched passive is active on the Cultist
CONTROL: the Cultist carries no Void-Touched before the strike
Blade of the Empire strikes the dummy
CONTROL: Blade of Yogg-Saron heals the Cultist
The Blade of Yogg-Saron heal marks the Cultist with one Void-Touched stack
